The garden was quiet at first light. A marigold near the fence
opened slowly, and a brisk breeze moved through the leaves. Maya liked to
meander along the stone path before breakfast, watching the luminous
mist lift toward tranquility.

Her grandmother kept a small patch beyond the wall. Each autumn they
harvest beans, squash, and the last stubborn peppers. It was a tradition
older than the island itself, though nobody could say when it began.
